threshold_formulas.fixed_boundary_parameter: Only opt[2][0][Na_gNa], scalar<f8>, must equal canonical raw negative-infinity bytes000000000000f0ff in initial and both resulting branches. All other raw parameter coordinates remain finite with the floating-leaf rule.
threshold_formulas.groups: difference_L2 <= relative_limit*min(norm_reference,norm_streamed). Limit1e-8 for five raw normalization groups, with strictly positive source norms; limit3e-8 for five normalized groups and three optimizer-output groups.
threshold_formulas.normalized_updates_optimizer_state_and_f: For each entire floating leaf define S=max(abs(values in both operands)); every component requires abs(a_i-b_i) <= 3e-12*S + 3e-8*max(abs(a_i),abs(b_i)). This is a scale-weighted absolute term, not an unscaled3e-12 absolute tolerance. Nonfloating counters require exact equality.
threshold_formulas.raw_gradient_leaf: For each entire leaf define S=max(abs(values in both operands)); every component requires abs(a_i-b_i) <= 1e-12*S + 1e-8*max(abs(a_i),abs(b_i)). A zero-scale leaf requires exact zero difference.
